$comment: Единственный источник полей H3 Director. Читают: app/director_config.py (сервер), preview/h3-director/director-config.mjs (Studio). Значения value уходят на сервер и в промпт — не переводить. label.ru/label.en — только для интерфейса.

options.prompt: Static Shot: the camera body and the lens stay completely still and the composition does not change.
The camera stays in one place and pans right across the scene.
The camera stays in one place and pans left across the scene.

The camera starts framed on the main subject, then whip pans right at fast speed and lands on the next target to the right; the space between smears into horizontal motion blur in the middle of the move and the frame settles sharply on the new target.

The camera starts framed on the main subject, then whip pans left at fast speed and lands on the next target to the left; the space between smears into horizontal motion blur in the middle of the move and the frame settles sharply on the new target.
The camera stays in one place and tilts up.
The camera stays in one place and tilts down.

The subject walks straight toward the lens, growing from a full figure to a close-up, and passes right beside the camera; the camera pans right at fast speed as they go by and follows them from behind as they walk on.

The camera stays in one place and tilts up at slow speed, travelling up the subject's legs, body and shoulders, and comes to rest on their face in a medium close-up, so they are only revealed at the end.
A wide shot looks across the place with no one in view; the camera stays in one place and pans right at slow speed and comes to rest on the subject, framing them in a medium shot.

The camera zooms in at slow speed on the main subject: only the zoom lens changes and the camera body never moves; nothing shifts against anything else, the background changes size flat together with the subject.

The camera zooms out at slow speed from the main subject: only the zoom lens changes and the camera body never moves; nothing shifts against anything else, the background changes size flat together with the subject.

The camera zooms in at fast speed on the main subject: only the zoom lens changes and the camera body never moves; nothing shifts against anything else, the background changes size flat together with the subject.

The camera zooms out at fast speed from the main subject: only the zoom lens changes and the camera body never moves; nothing shifts against anything else, the background changes size flat together with the subject.

The camera is locked off on a tripod and holds the wide shot completely still at first; only the zoom lens changes and the camera body never moves. Between one frame and the next the lens crash zooms in to a tight close-up of the main subject's face: the whole change takes only two or three frames, as abrupt as a cut, and nothing shifts against anything else, the background simply magnifies flat. After it lands the close-up is locked and does not change; the reaction lands with the zoom.

The camera is locked off on a tripod and holds the tight close-up completely still at first; only the zoom lens changes and the camera body never moves. Between one frame and the next the lens crash zooms out to a wide shot with the main subject small and complete in frame: the whole change takes only two or three frames, as abrupt as a cut, and nothing shifts against anything else, the background simply shrinks flat. After it lands the wide framing is locked and does not change.

The camera begins in a tight close-up of the subject's face, then zooms out, accelerating harder and harder until the subject is tiny in the far distance; it holds there for about a second, then zooms back in with large amplitude at fast speed to the same close-up.
The camera pushes in toward the main subject; nearer objects slide past the edges of frame, so the move reads as travel with parallax, not as a zoom.
The camera pulls out away from the main subject and reveals more of the space around it.
The camera trucks right, travelling sideways while it keeps facing the same way.
The camera trucks left, travelling sideways while it keeps facing the same way.
The camera pedestals up, the whole camera rising straight up while it keeps facing the same way.
The camera pedestals down, the whole camera lowering straight down while it keeps facing the same way.
The camera trucks right with small amplitude at slow speed, a short slide that shows gentle parallax.
The camera trucks left with small amplitude at slow speed, a short slide that shows gentle parallax.
The camera pushes in past a foreground edge close to the lens, which sweeps out of frame as the camera passes it, and continues into the space beyond.
The camera performs an arc shot to the right around the main subject, who stays where they are.
The camera performs an arc shot to the left around the main subject, who stays where they are.
The camera performs an arc shot clockwise around the main subject with large amplitude at fast speed, sweeping a complete circle and coming back to the front; the subject stays where they are.
The camera performs an arc shot counterclockwise around the main subject with large amplitude at fast speed, sweeping a complete circle and coming back to the front; the subject stays where they are.

The camera sits low near the ground and performs an arc shot around the subject with large amplitude at fast speed, circling them while looking up as they rise to full height, the sky wheeling behind them.
Tracking Shot: the camera follows the moving subject and keeps them at the same readable distance.
Tracking Shot from behind: the camera follows the subject at shoulder height, their back to the camera.
Tracking Shot: the camera pulls out in front of the subject as they advance toward it, keeping their face in frame.
Tracking Shot: the camera trucks alongside the subject, level with them, keeping a clear profile.
Tracking Shot close to the ground: the camera follows the movement low, keeping the ground-level detail in frame.
Tracking Shot: the camera travels with the vehicle, which stays steady in frame while the background streams past.
Tracking Shot at fast speed: the camera chases the moving subject closely, reacting to each turn while the subject stays readable.

The camera pushes in with large amplitude at fast speed, charging the whole length of the space toward the subject: near objects sweep outward past the edges of frame as the camera passes them, the ground streams underneath, and the move ends in a tight close-up of the subject's face.
The camera pushes in with large amplitude at slow speed toward the subject's face and keeps going past it until one eye fills the entire frame edge to edge.
The camera stays low near the ground and tilted up at the subject the whole time, and pushes in at slow speed until they tower over the frame, looking down past the lens.
The camera shakes slightly while it performs a tracking shot alongside the subject, the frame drifting and correcting with the operator's steps.

The camera is fixed rigidly to the subject and holds their face locked dead-centre at exactly the same size and position throughout, while the whole background lurches, sways and swings behind them with each step.
The camera starts low at ground level beside the subject, then performs a tracking shot, pedestalling up and tilting down to follow them from high overhead while they stay centred and sharp in frame.
The camera cranes down at slow speed, pedestalling down and tilting up as it descends, and comes to rest at eye level in a medium close-up of the subject's face.
Glide forward through open space toward the subject or destination.
The camera pulls out with large amplitude at fast speed while pedestalling up, rising and retreating until the subject is small and alone far below and the whole location opens out around them.
Use a broad high-altitude path over the landscape.

The camera jibs up at slow speed in one sweeping arc, rising from the subject's chest height up and over them while tilting down to keep them in frame, and ends in a high angle looking down with the location spread out around them.

The camera swings down in front of the subject in a smooth quarter-circle arc at slow speed, keeping the same distance the whole way: from straight above their head down to their eye level on the side they face, tilting from pointing straight down to pointing level.

The camera flies like a racing FPV drone: it dives steeply at fast speed, rolls and banks through the air, skims low and fast over the ground toward the subject, then pulls up and slows to a stop in a medium shot of them, face sharp.

A first-person POV shot: the camera is the eyes of an unseen viewer and moves exactly as the viewer's head does, swaying gently with each step; only the viewer's own hand ever appears, from the bottom of frame.
Hold or gently glide above the scene with a miniature-scale focus treatment.
Zoom continuously into the centered target until it fills the frame.
Pull outward from the starting location through larger geographic scales.

A static shot locked off on a tripod: the subject stays still while everything around them plays as a fast time-lapse, people and traffic streaming past as soft blurred streaks and the light changing quickly.
Move toward a visible opening or surface and continue into the revealed space.

Throughout the entire shot the main subject's size and position in frame stay exactly constant, framed identically in the last frame as in the first and never drifting from the centre. The camera pushes in while simultaneously zooming out at exactly the matching rate, so only the background behind the subject stretches away and warps.
The camera rolls clockwise into a canted dutch angle and holds there, the horizon tilted, the subject off-axis.

The camera holds a static shot. The near subject is in sharp focus while the far subject behind them is soft; the focus then racks from the near face to the far subject, and the near subject falls into soft blur exactly as the far one resolves sharply.

lighting.$comment: Авто/Да: Studio рисует сферу с этим светом и прикладывает её к заданию как <Picture N> с ролью «Свет». Нет — только текст.

color.$comment: Не идёт в текст промпта: управляет узлом H3ColorGrade (сила переноса цвета с фото).
